dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, who used the dishwasher last night? It's full of clean dishes.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈhuː ˈjuːzd ðə ˈdɪʃwɑːʃər ˈlæst ˈnaɪt? ɪts ˈfʊl əv ˈkliːn ˈdɪʃɪz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I did. Sorry, I'll empty it now.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdɪd. ˈsɑːri, aɪl ˈɛmpti ɪt ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Thanks. And who takes the trash downstairs this week?
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋks. ənd ˈhuː ˈteɪks ðə ˈtræʃ ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz ðɪs ˈwiːk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You do! I did it last week.
dialogue.reading: juː ˈduː! aɪ ˈdɪd ɪt ˈlæst ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh, right. Who's cooking this evening?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ˈraɪt. ˈhuːz ˈkʊkɪŋ ðɪs ˈiːvnɪŋ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I am. But first, who wrote "chocolate cake" on our shopping list?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈæm. bʌt ˈfɜːrst, ˈhuː ˈroʊt ˈtʃɔːklət ˈkeɪk ɑːn aʊr ˈʃɑːpɪŋ ˌlɪst?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: I did! And who waters the plants? They look very dry.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdɪd! ənd ˈhuː ˈwɔːtərz ðə ˈplænts? ðeɪ ˈlʊk ˈvɛri ˈdraɪ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I usually do. I'll water the plants this afternoon.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ˈduː. aɪl ˈwɔːtər ðə ˈplænts ðɪs ˌæftərˈnuːn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Great. And who feeds Mrs. Lee's cat? She's on vacation.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ənd ˈhuː ˈfiːdz ˈmɪsɪz ˈliːz ˈkæt? ʃiːz ɑːn veɪˈkeɪʃən.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I do. She gave me her key, so I go to her apartment every morning.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈduː. ʃiː ˈɡeɪv miː hɜːr ˈkiː, soʊ aɪ ˈɡoʊ tə hɜːr əˈpɑːrtmənt ˈɛvri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ.
